bookInfo.name: New History of the Five Dynasties
bookInfo.author: Ouyang Xiu

title.zh: 卷八 晉本紀第八: 高祖
title.raw: 卷八 晉本紀第八: 高祖 Volume 8 Later Jin Annals 1: Gaozu

sentences.zh: 高祖聖文章武明德孝皇帝，其父臬捩雞，本出於西夷，自朱邪歸唐，從朱邪入居陰山。

translations.literal: Gaozu, the Sagely, Literary, Martial, Virtuous, and Filial Emperor—his father was Niezhji. He was originally of the western barbarians; from the Zhuye he submitted to Tang and, with the Zhuye, came to dwell in the Yin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu, temple name the Sagely, Literary, Martial, Virtuous, and Filial Emperor, was born to Niezhji. The family sprang from western tribes; they left the Zhuye for Tang service and settled with them in the Yin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 其後，晉王李克用起於雲、朔之間，臬捩雞以善騎射，常從晉王征伐有功，官至洺州刺史。

translations.literal: Later the Jin Prince Li Keyong rose between Yun and Shuo. Niezhji, skilled in mounted archery, often followed the Jin Prince on campaigns with merit, and reached the office of prefect of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Keyong, Prince of Jin, raised his banners in Yun and Shuo, Niezhji rode with him as a crack horse-archer, won repeated credit in the field, and rose to prefect of Ming.

sentences.zh: 臬捩雞生敬瑭，其姓石氏，不知其得姓之始也。

translations.literal: Niezhji begat Jingtang. Their surname was Shi; the beginning of how they obtained the surname is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Niezhji’s son was Jingtang. The clan took the surname Shi; when or how they first bore it is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭為人沈厚寡言，明宗愛之，妻以女，是為永寧公主，由是常隸明宗帳下，號左射軍。

translations.literal: Jingtang was deep and reserved in speech and sparing of words. Mingzong loved him and gave him a daughter in marriage—she became Princess Yongning—whereupon he regularly served under Mingzong’s banner and was styled the Left Shooter Army.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang was grave and taciturn. Mingzong favored him, married him to a princess—Princess Yongning—and kept him in his personal train as commander of the Left Shooter Army.

sentences.zh: 莊宗已得魏，梁將劉掞急攻清平，莊宗馳救之。

translations.literal: After Zhuangzong had taken Wei, the Liang general Liu Yan pressed the attack on Qingping. Zhuangzong galloped to its relief.
translations.idiomatic: Once Zhuangzong held Wei, Liu Yan of Liang hammered Qingping until Zhuangzong raced to relieve the town.

sentences.zh: 兵未及陣，為掞所掩，敬瑭以十餘騎橫槊馳擊，取之以旋。

translations.literal: Before the army had reached the battle line, Yan enveloped them. Jingtang with a dozen-odd horsemen charged crosswise with levelled lance, seized him, and wheeled back.
translations.idiomatic: Yan caught the column before it could form. Jingtang led barely a dozen riders in a slashing charge, took Yan prisoner, and broke clear.

sentences.zh: 莊宗拊其背而壯之，手啗以酥，啗酥，夷狄所重，由是名動軍中。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong clapped his back in praise of his valor and with his own hand fed him curd; curd was what the barbarians prized, and from this his name shook the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong smote his back in admiration and fed him curd from his own hand—a delicacy the nomads prized—so that Jingtang’s fame rang through the host.

sentences.zh: 十五年，莊宗戰於胡柳，前鋒周德威戰死，敬瑭以左射軍從明宗復擊敗梁兵。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Zhuangzong fought at Huliu. The vanguard Zhou Dewei died in battle. Jingtang with the Left Shooter Army followed Mingzong in a renewed attack and defeated the Liang army.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifteen Zhuangzong fought at Huliu; Zhou Dewei, his vanguard, fell. Jingtang and the Left Shooter Army followed Mingzong in a counter-stroke and broke the Liang line.

sentences.zh: 明宗戰胡盧套、楊村，為梁兵所敗，敬瑭常脫明宗於危。

translations.literal: Mingzong fought at Hulu Tao and Yangcun and was defeated by the Liang army. Jingtang often snatched Mingzong from peril.
translations.idiomatic: At Hulu Tao and Yangcun Mingzong met defeat; again and again Jingtang pulled him out of the killing ground.

sentences.zh: 趙在禮之亂，明宗討之，至魏而兵變，明宗初欲自歸於天子，明己所以不反者。

translations.literal: In Zhao Zaili’s rebellion Mingzong campaigned against him. Reaching Wei the army mutinied. At first Mingzong wished to return himself to the Son of Heaven and make clear why he was not rebelling.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Zaili rebelled Mingzong marched to suppress him; at Wei the troops mutinied. Mingzong at first meant to go back to court and swear he had not risen in revolt.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭獻計曰：「豈有軍變於外，上將獨無事者乎？

translations.literal: Jingtang offered a plan, saying: “When the army mutinies abroad, can the commander alone be without blame?
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang urged: “If soldiers mutiny in the field, can their general stand blameless?

sentences.zh: 且猶豫者兵家大忌，不如速行。

translations.literal: Moreover hesitation is the great taboo of war; better to march at once.
translations.idiomatic: Hesitation is the soldier’s worst enemy—strike now.”

sentences.zh: 願得騎兵三百先攻汴州，夷門天下之要害也，得之可以成事。

translations.literal: I beg three hundred cavalry to attack Bianzhou first. Yimen is the vital point of the realm; gaining it, the deed can be accomplished.”
translations.idiomatic: Give me three hundred horse to seize Bian first. Yimen is the empire’s throat; hold it and the throne is within reach.”

sentences.zh: 」明宗然之，與之驍騎三百，渡黎陽為前鋒，明宗遂入汴。

translations.literal: Mingzong approved. He gave him three hundred elite horse. Crossing Liyang as vanguard, Mingzong then entered Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong agreed and lent him three hundred picked riders. Jingtang crossed Liyang in the van; Mingzong entered Bian on his heels.

sentences.zh: 莊宗自洛後至，不得入，而兵皆潰去。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong came from Luoyang afterward, could not enter, and the troops all scattered and left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong arrived from Luoyang too late, could not get in, and his army melted away.

sentences.zh: 莊宗西還，明宗以敬瑭為前鋒趣汜水，且收其散卒。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong returned west. Mingzong sent Jingtang as vanguard to hurry to Sishui and also gather the scattered soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong withdrew westward. Mingzong sent Jingtang ahead to Sishui to round up the stragglers.

sentences.zh: 莊宗遇弒，明宗入立，拜敬瑭保義軍節度使，賜號「竭忠建策興復功臣」，兼六軍諸衛副使。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong met assassination. Mingzong entered and took the throne. Jingtang was appointed military governor of the Baoyi army, granted the title “Meritorious in Exhausting Loyalty and Framing Policy for Restoration,” and made concurrently deputy commander of the Six Armies and the imperial guards.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhuangzong’s murder Mingzong took the throne. He made Jingtang governor of Baoyi, titled him “Loyal Architect of Restoration,” and named him deputy over the Six Armies and palace guards.

sentences.zh: 在陜為政以廉聞。

translations.literal: In Shaan his government was known for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: At his post in Shaan he won renown for clean rule.

sentences.zh: 是時，諸侯多不奉法，鄧州陶玘、亳州李鄴皆以贓汙論死，明宗下詔書褒廉吏普州安崇阮、洺州張萬進、耀州孫嶽等以諷天下，而以敬瑭為首。

translations.literal: At that time many feudatories did not observe the law. Tao Qi of Dengzhou and Li Ye of Bozhou were both sentenced to death for corruption. Mingzong issued an edict praising honest officials—An Chongruan of Puzhou, Zhang Wanjin of Mingzhou, Sun Yue of Yaozhou, and others—to admonish the realm, with Jingtang at their head.
translations.idiomatic: Feudatories then flouted the law wholesale; Tao Qi of Deng and Li Ye of Bo died for graft. Mingzong published an edict holding up honest governors—An Chongruan, Zhang Wanjin, Sun Yue, and the rest—with Jingtang first among them.

sentences.zh: 天成二年十月，從幸汴州，為御營使，拜宣武軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使，六軍副使如故，改賜「耀忠匡定保節功臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of Tiancheng 2 he followed the emperor to Bianzhou, became imperial camp commissioner, was appointed military governor of the Xuanwu army and commander of the Palace Attendant Personal Army horse and foot, the deputy command of the Six Armies remaining as before, and the grant was changed to “Meritorious in Glorious Loyalty in Securing the Realm and Preserving the Fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Tiancheng 2 he accompanied the court to Bian, became imperial camp commissioner, took Xuanwu and command of the Palace Attendant Personal horse and foot while keeping his Six Armies deputy post, and received the new title “Loyal Guardian of the Realm and Keeper of the Fief.”

sentences.zh: 」三年四月，徙鎮天雄，拜同中書門下平章事、興唐尹。

translations.literal: ” In the fourth month of year 3 he was transferred to command Tianxiong, appointed Co-Grand Councilor and metropolitan magistrate of Xingtang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year he moved to Tianxiong, became co-grand councilor, and served as metropolitan magistrate of Xingtang.

sentences.zh: 五月，拜駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was appointed commissioner of the imperial son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was made commissioner of imperial sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 董璋反東川，為行營都招討使，不克而還。

translations.literal: Dong Zhang rebelled in eastern Sichuan. Jingtang was made grand suppression commissioner of the field army but did not overcome him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhang rose in eastern Sichuan. Jingtang led the campaign army against him, failed to win, and came back.

sentences.zh: 復兼六軍諸衛副使。

translations.literal: He again held the deputy command of the Six Armies and imperial guards.
translations.idiomatic: He resumed his deputy post over the Six Armies and guards.

sentences.zh: 徙鎮河陽三城，未行，而契丹、吐渾、突厥皆入寇，是時，秦王從榮統六軍，敬瑭疑其必及禍，不欲為其副，乃自請行。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Heyang three cities but had not yet departed when the Khitan, Tuyuhun, and Turks all raided the borders. At that time the Prince of Qin, Congrong, commanded the Six Armies. Jingtang suspected he would meet disaster and did not wish to serve as his deputy, so he himself requested to take the field.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could leave for Heyang, Khitan, Tuyuhun, and Turkish bands struck the frontiers. Congrong, Prince of Qin, held the Six Armies. Fearing ruin as his deputy, Jingtang volunteered for frontier duty.

sentences.zh: 及制出，不落副使，輒復辭行。

translations.literal: When the appointment came out it did not drop the deputy post; he again declined and refused to go.
translations.idiomatic: The commission left him still deputy commander; he refused the order a second time.

sentences.zh: 明宗數責大臣問誰可行者，範延光、趙延壽等卒以敬瑭為請，乃拜河東節度使、大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步軍總管，落六軍副使，乃行。

translations.literal: Mingzong several times reproved his ministers and asked who could go. Fan Yanguang, Zhao Yanshou, and the rest finally nominated Jingtang. He was then appointed military governor of Hedong and overall commander of Han and tribal horse and foot of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, the Six Armies deputy post was dropped, and he set out.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong upbraided his council again and again for a suitable man. Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou at last proposed Jingtang. He received Hedong and command over Han and tribal forces of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and the rest, shed the Six Armies deputy title, and marched.

sentences.zh: 天福元年五月，徙鎮天平，敬瑭果不受命，謂其屬曰：「先帝授吾太原使老焉，今無故而遷，是疑吾反也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Tianfu 1 he was transferred to command Tianping. Jingtang truly refused the order. He told his followers: “The late emperor gave me Taiyuan to grow old in; now I am moved for no reason—this is suspicion that I will rebel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Tianfu 1 the court ordered him to Tianping. Jingtang defied the transfer. He told his staff: “The late emperor set me in Taiyuan to end my days; a move without cause means they think me a traitor.

sentences.zh: 且太原地險而粟多，吾當內檄諸鎮，外求援於契丹，可乎？

translations.literal: Moreover Taiyuan’s land is perilous and its grain abundant. I ought to summon the circuits within and seek aid from the Khitan without—can this be done?”
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan is a fortress with deep granaries. I will call the provinces to arms and beg the Khitan for help—will you follow?”

sentences.zh: 」桑維翰、劉知遠等共以為然。

translations.literal: Sang Weihan, Liu Zhiyuan, and the rest together deemed it right.
translations.idiomatic: Sang Weihan, Liu Zhiyuan, and the others agreed.

sentences.zh: 乃上表論廢帝不當立，請立許王從益為明宗嗣。

translations.literal: He then memorialized that the Deposed Emperor ought not to have been enthroned and asked that Prince of Xu Congyi be established as Mingzong’s successor.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Congke had usurped the throne and urged enthroning Prince of Xu Congyi as Mingzong’s heir.

sentences.zh: 廢帝下詔削奪敬瑭官爵，命張敬達等討之，敬瑭求援於契丹。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor issued an edict stripping Jingtang of office and rank and ordered Zhang Jingda and others to campaign against him. Jingtang sought aid from the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Congke stripped his titles and sent Zhang Jingda against him. Jingtang turned to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 九月，契丹耶律德光入自雁門，與唐兵戰，敬達大敗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Yelü Deguang of the Khitan entered through Yanmen and fought the Tang army. Jingda was utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yelü Deguang came through Yanmen Pass; the Tang forces under Jingda were shattered.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭夜出北門見耶律德光，約為父子。

translations.literal: Jingtang by night went out the north gate to see Yelü Deguang and agreed to become father and son.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang slipped out the north gate by night, met Yelü Deguang, and pledged himself as the Khitan emperor’s adopted son.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，皇帝即位，國號晉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingyou, the emperor took the throne. The state was named Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the eleventh month he ascended the throne as emperor of Jin.

sentences.zh: 以幽、涿、薊、檀、順、瀛、莫、蔚、朔、雲、應、新、媯、儒、武、寰州入於契丹。

translations.literal: You, Zhuo, Ji, Tan, Shun, Ying, Mo, Yu, Shuo, Yun, Ying, Xin, Gui, Ru, Wu, and Huan prefectures were ceded to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen prefectures—including You, Zhuo, Ji, Tan, and the rest—were handed to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On jihai a great amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the throne proclaimed a general amnesty and a new reign title.

sentences.zh: 掌書記桑維翰為翰林學士、尚書禮部侍郎，知樞密使事。

translations.literal: Chief secretary Sang Weihan became Hanlin academician and vice minister of rites, and directed affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sang Weihan, chief secretary, became Hanlin academician and vice minister of rites with charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙寅，翰林學士承旨、尚書戶部侍郎趙瑩為門下侍郎，桑維翰為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事，兼樞密使。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingyin, Hanlin academician and director Zhao Ying became vice director of the Chancellery; Sang Weihan became vice director of the Secretariat: both co-grand councilors, with Sang also commissioner of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the intercalary month Zhao Ying, Hanlin director, entered the Chancellery; Sang Weihan joined the Secretariat—both as co-grand councilors, Sang also as commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，趙德鈞及其子延壽叛於唐來降，契丹鎖之以歸。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zhao Dejun and his son Yanshou rebelled in Tang and came to surrender; the Khitan fettered them and took them back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhao Dejun and Yanshou defected from Tang; the Khitan bound them and led them away.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次河陽，節度使萇從簡叛於唐來降。

translations.literal: On jimao the emperor halted at Heyang. Military governor Chang Congjian rebelled in Tang and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he stopped at Heyang. Chang Congjian of Tang came over to him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，至自太原。

translations.literal: On xinsi he arrived from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he entered the capital from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 盧文紀、姚顗罷。

translations.literal: Lu Wenji and Yao Yi were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenji and Yao Yi left office.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大赦，殺張延朗、劉延朗，赦房暠。

translations.literal: On jiashen a great amnesty was proclaimed. Zhang Yanlang and Liu Yanlang were executed; Fang Hao was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen came a general amnesty. Zhang Yanlang and Liu Yanlang were put to death; Fang Hao was spared.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，如河陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, he went to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the twelfth month he traveled to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 追降王從珂為庶人。

translations.literal: Congke was demoted posthumously to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Congke was stripped to commoner rank in absentia.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，司空馮道兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On dinghai Minister of Works Feng Dao was made concurrently vice director of the Chancellery and co-grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Feng Dao, minister of works, became vice director of the Chancellery and co-grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，曹州指揮使石重立殺其刺史鄭玩。

translations.literal: On jichou Shi Chongli, commander of Caozhou, killed his prefect Zheng Wan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Shi Chongli, Caozhou commander, murdered Prefect Zheng Wan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，御劄求直言。

translations.literal: On xinmao an imperial rescript sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the throne called for frank memorials.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鎮州牙內都虞候秘瓊逐其節度副使李彥琦。

translations.literal: On guisi Bi Qiong, inner garrison commander of Zhenzhou, drove out his deputy military governor Li Yanqi.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Bi Qiong, Zhenzhou’s inner garrison commander, expelled Deputy Governor Li Yanqi.

sentences.zh: 同州裨將門鐸殺其將楊漢賓。

translations.literal: A Tongzhou lieutenant, Men Duo, killed his commander Yang Hanbin.
translations.idiomatic: At Tongzhou the lieutenant Men Duo slew his commander Yang Hanbin.

sentences.zh: 庚子，天平軍節度使王建立殺其副使李彥赟。

translations.literal: On gengzi Wang Jianli, military governor of Tianping, killed his deputy Li Yanyun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wang Jianli of Tianping murdered his deputy Li Yanyun.

sentences.zh: 旱。

translations.literal: Drought.
translations.idiomatic: The land suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸亥，安遠軍節度使盧文進叛降於吳。

translations.literal: In spring of year 2, on guihai the first day of the first month, Lu Wenzhi, military governor of Anyuan, rebelled and surrendered to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the second year, on guihai of the first month, Lu Wenzhi of Anyuan defected to Wu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，天雄軍節度使範延光殺齊州防禦使秘瓊。

translations.literal: On dingmao Fan Yanguang, military governor of Tianxiong, killed Qi prefecture defense commissioner Bi Qiong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Fan Yanguang of Tianxiong executed Bi Qiong, defense commissioner of Qi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，兵部侍郎李崧為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuyin Li Song, vice minister of war, became vice director of the Secretariat, co-grand councilor, and commissioner of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Song, vice minister of war, entered the Secretariat as co-grand councilor and commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 封唐宗室子為公，及隋酅公為二王後，以周介公備三恪。

translations.literal: Sons of the Tang imperial house were enfeoffed as dukes; the Sui Duke of Xi was made second of the Two Kings; the Zhou Duke of Jie was kept as third of the Three Guests.
translations.idiomatic: Tang imperial clansmen were made dukes; the Sui heir at Xi joined the Two Kings; the Zhou heir at Jie completed the Three Guests.

sentences.zh: 二月丁西，契丹使太子解裏來。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingyou, the Khitan sent the crown prince Jieli.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Khitan crown prince Jieli arrived.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，如汴州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, he went to Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the third month he traveled to Bian.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，赦囚，蠲民租賦。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dinghai, prisoners were pardoned and the people’s land tax and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the fourth month of summer he pardoned prisoners and cut land taxes.

sentences.zh: 趙瑩使於契丹。

translations.literal: Zhao Ying was sent as envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ying went on embassy to the Khitan court.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宣武軍節度使楊光遠進助國錢。

translations.literal: On xinmao Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Xuanwu, presented money to assist the state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Yang Guangyuan of Xuanwu offered funds to the treasury.

sentences.zh: 契丹使宮苑使李可興來。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent the palace commissioner Li Kexing.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan dispatched Palace Commissioner Li Kexing.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，御劄求直言。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renxu, an imperial rescript sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the fifth month the throne again called for frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，追尊祖考為皇帝，妣為皇后：高祖璟謚曰孝安，廟號靖祖，祖妣秦氏謚曰孝安元；

translations.literal: On dingchou the emperor posthumously honored his forebears as emperor and empress: Gaozu Jing was given the posthumous title Filial Tranquil and temple name Revered Ancestor; his grandmother Lady Qin was given the posthumous title Filial Tranquil Primary;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he raised his ancestors: Jing as Revered Ancestor with the posthumous name Filial Tranquil; Grandmother Qin as empress with the title Filial Tranquil Primary;

sentences.zh: 曾祖彬謚曰孝簡，廟號肅祖，祖妣安氏謚曰孝簡恭；

translations.literal: great-grandfather Bin was given the posthumous title Filial Simple and temple name Solemn Ancestor; his grandmother Lady An was given the posthumous title Filial Simple Reverent;
translations.idiomatic: Bin as Solemn Ancestor, Filial Simple; Grandmother An, Filial Simple Reverent;

sentences.zh: 祖昱謚曰孝平，廟號睿祖，祖妣來氏謚曰孝平獻；

translations.literal: grandfather Yu was given the posthumous title Filial Equable and temple name Sagacious Ancestor; his grandmother Lady Lai was given the posthumous title Filial Equable Offering;
translations.idiomatic: Yu as Sagacious Ancestor, Filial Equable; Grandmother Lai, Filial Equable Offering;

sentences.zh: 考紹雍謚曰孝元，廟號獻祖，妣何氏謚曰孝元懿。

translations.literal: his father Shaoyong was given the posthumous title Filial Origin and temple name Offering Ancestor; his mother Lady He was given the posthumous title Filial Origin Exemplary.
translations.idiomatic: his father Shaoyong as Offering Ancestor, Filial Origin; his mother Lady He, Filial Origin Exemplary.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，契丹使夷離畢來。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guiwei, the Khitan sent the yilijue.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the sixth month a Khitan yilijue envoy arrived.

sentences.zh: 天雄軍節度使範延光反。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang, military governor of Tianxiong, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang, governor of Tianxiong, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，傳箭於義成軍節度使符彥饒。

translations.literal: On dingyou the signal arrow was passed to Fu Yanrao, military governor of Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court flashed the campaign arrow to Fu Yanrao of Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 丁未，楊光遠為魏府四面行營都部署。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yang Guangyuan became overall deployment commander of the four-sided Wei prefecture field army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yang Guangyuan took overall command of the Wei field armies on four sides.

sentences.zh: 東都巡檢張從賓反，留守判官李遐死之，奉國都指揮使侯益、護聖都指揮使杜重威討之。

translations.literal: Zhang Congbin, eastern capital inspector, rebelled. The defender’s aide Li Xia died. Hou Yi, commander of the Fengguo army, and Du Chongwei, commander of the Husheng army, campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Congbin mutinied at the eastern capital; Defender’s aide Li Xia was killed. Hou Yi of Fengguo and Du Chongwei of Husheng marched against him.

sentences.zh: 從賓寇河陽，殺皇子重乂；

translations.literal: Congbin raided Heyang and killed the prince Chongyi;
translations.idiomatic: Congbin struck Heyang and slew Prince Chongyi;

sentences.zh: 寇河南，殺皇子重信。

translations.literal: he raided Henan and killed the prince Chongxin.
translations.idiomatic: then Henan, where he killed Prince Chongxin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，從賓陷汜水關，殺巡檢使宋廷浩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn Congbin took Sishui Pass and killed the inspector Song Tinghao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Congbin seized Sishui Pass and killed Inspector Song Tinghao.

sentences.zh: 壬子，右衛大將軍尹暉叛奔於吳，不克，伏誅。

translations.literal: On renzi Senior General of the Right Guards Yin Hui rebelled and fled toward Wu but did not succeed and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yin Hui of the Right Guards tried to defect to Wu, failed, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 右監門衛大將軍婁繼英叛降於張從賓。

translations.literal: Senior General of the Right Gate Guards Lou Jiying rebelled and surrendered to Zhang Congbin.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Jiying of the Right Gate Guards went over to Zhang Congbin.

sentences.zh: 義成軍亂，殺戍將侍衛馬步軍都指揮使白奉進。

translations.literal: Yicheng army mutinied and killed the garrison commander, Palace Attendant Personal Army horse and foot commander Bai Fengjin.
translations.idiomatic: Yicheng rose in mutiny and killed the garrison commander Bai Fengjin, who also commanded the Palace Attendant Personal Army.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，戍將奉國指揮使馬萬執符彥饒歸於京師，命殺之於赤岡。

translations.literal: On jiayin the garrison commander, Fengguo army commander Ma Wan, seized Fu Yanrao and brought him to the capital. He was ordered executed at Chigang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Ma Wan of Fengguo captured Fu Yanrao and delivered him to court; he was beheaded at Chigang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，楊光遠為魏府行營都招討使。

translations.literal: On yimao Yang Guangyuan became grand suppression commissioner of the Wei field army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yang Guangyuan was named grand suppression commissioner for the Wei campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，杜重威克汜水關。

translations.literal: On xinyou Du Chongwei took Sishui Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Du Chongwei recovered Sishui Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬申，楊光遠克博州。

translations.literal: On renshen Yang Guangyuan took Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yang Guangyuan captured Bo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，安州屯防指揮使王暉殺其節度使周瑰，右衛上將軍李金全討之。

translations.literal: On bingzi Wang Hui, garrison commander of Anzhou, killed his military governor Zhou Gui. Senior General of the Right Guards Li Jinquan campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wang Hui of Anzhou murdered Governor Zhou Gui; Li Jinquan of the Right Guards was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，靜難軍節度使安叔千進添都馬。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen, An Shuqian, military governor of Jingnan, presented additional horses for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the eighth month An Shuqian of Jingnan sent extra horses for the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，赦非死罪囚及張從賓、符彥饒、王暉余黨。

translations.literal: On yisi prisoners not under death sentence were pardoned, as were the remaining partisans of Zhang Congbin, Fu Yanrao, and Wang Hui.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the throne pardoned all but capital crimes and the remnants of Congbin’s, Fu’s, and Wang’s factions.

sentences.zh: 九月，楊光遠進粟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Yang Guangyuan presented grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yang Guangyuan sent grain tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，禁造甲兵。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinsi, the manufacture of armor and weapons was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the tenth month private armories were banned.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月戊戌，諸鎮皆進物以助國。

translations.literal: In spring of year 3, on the second month, day wuxu, all the military governors presented goods to assist the state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the second month in the third year every circuit sent goods to swell the treasury.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，回鶻可汗王仁美使翟全福來。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renxu, the Uyghur khan Wang Renmei sent Zhai Quanfu as envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the third month Wang Renmei, khan of the Uyghurs, dispatched Zhai Quanfu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禁私造銅器。

translations.literal: On dingchou the private casting of copper vessels was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou private bronze casting was outlawed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，以皇業錢作受命寶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, imperial enterprise coin was cast into the Seal of Received Mandate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the seventh month court coin was recast as the Seal of Received Mandate.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，馮道及左僕射劉句為契丹冊禮使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuyin, Feng Dao and Left Vice Director Liu Gou were made envoys for the Khitan investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the eighth month Feng Dao and Left Vice Director Liu Gou led the embassy to invest the Khitan emperor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，澶州刺史馮暉降。

translations.literal: On renwu Prefect Feng Hui of Chan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Feng Hui, prefect of Chan, submitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，許禦署官選。

translations.literal: On bingxu provisional appointments to office were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the throne allowed provisional commissions.

sentences.zh: 己丑，蠲水旱民稅。

translations.literal: On jichou taxes of the people in flood and drought districts were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou flood- and drought-struck districts were granted tax relief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，歸伶官於契丹。

translations.literal: On xinchou palace actors were returned to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou court musicians were sent back to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，赦範延光。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yiyou, Fan Yanguang was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the ninth month Fan Yanguang received amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己未，歸靜鞭官劉守威，金吾勘契官王殷、司天雞叫學生殷暉於契丹。

translations.literal: On jiwei Jingbian officer Liu Shouwei, Golden Guard tally officer Wang Yin, and Directorate of Astronomy cock-crow student Yin Hui were returned to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Liu Shouwei of the Jingbian guard, Wang Yin of the Golden Guard tallies, and Yin Hui, student of the Directorate cock-crow office, were sent back to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 于闐使馬繼榮來，回鶻使李萬金來。

translations.literal: The Khotan envoy Ma Jirong came; the Uyghur envoy Li Wanjin came.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys arrived from Khotan—Ma Jirong—and from the Uyghurs—Li Wanjin.

sentences.zh: 己巳，赦魏州，蠲民稅。

translations.literal: On jisi Wei prefecture was granted amnesty and the people’s taxes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the court pardoned Wei prefecture and cut the people’s taxes.

sentences.zh: 是月，宣徽南院使劉處讓為樞密使。

translations.literal: That month Liu Churang, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendants, became commissioner of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Churang of the Southern Palace Attendants Bureau was made commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，契丹使中書令韓頻來奉冊曰英武明義皇帝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin, the Khitan sent Chief Councillor Han Pin bearing the investiture document naming him Heroic Martial and Clear Righteousness Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the tenth month the Khitan chief councillor Han Pin arrived with the investiture scroll, styling him Heroic Martial and Clear Righteousness Emperor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，升汴州為東京，以洛陽為西京，雍州為晉昌軍。

translations.literal: On gengchen Bian was raised to Eastern Capital, Luoyang made Western Capital, and Yong prefecture made the Jinchang army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Bian became the Eastern Capital, Luoyang the Western Capital, and Yong the Jinchang garrison.

sentences.zh: 戊子，右金吾衛大將軍馬從斌使於契丹。

translations.literal: On wuzi Ma Congbin, senior general of the Right Golden Guards, went on embassy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Ma Congbin of the Right Golden Guards went on embassy to the Khitan court.

sentences.zh: 己未，契丹使梅裏來。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Khitan envoy Meili came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Khitan envoy Meili arrived.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuxu a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚子，封李聖天為大寶于闐國王。

translations.literal: On gengzi Li Shengtian was enfeoffed as king of Great Treasure Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Shengtian was crowned king of Great Treasure Khotan.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，升廣晉府為鄴都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinhai, Guangjin prefecture was raised to the capital of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the eleventh month Guangjin was elevated to the capital of Ye.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，除鑄錢令。

translations.literal: On renxu the prohibition on coin casting was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the ban on private coin was lifted.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，封子重貴為鄭王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, his son Chonggui was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the twelfth month his son Chonggui was made Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，盜發唐湣皇帝墓。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, in the first month, tomb robbers opened the tomb of Tang’s Deposed Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year tomb robbers broke into the Deposed Emperor of Tang’s grave.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，澶州防禦使張從恩為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Zhang Cong’en, defense commissioner of Chan, became deputy commissioner of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhang Cong’en of Chan became deputy commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 旌表深州民李自倫門閭。

translations.literal: The gate and lane of Li Zilun, a commoner of Shen prefecture, were honored with commemorative markers.
translations.idiomatic: The home of Li Zilun, a commoner of Shen, was marked with an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，回鶻使其都督拽裏敦來。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yisi, the Uyghur sent their commander-in-chief Zhuailidun.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the third month the Uyghurs sent their commander Zhuailidun.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，頒《調元曆》。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Tiaoyuan Calendar was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the court issued the Tiaoyuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 靈州戍將王彥忠以懷遠城反。

translations.literal: Wang Yanchong, garrison commander at Lingzhou, rebelled holding Huaiyuan city.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchong, Lingzhou garrison commander, seized Huaiyuan and rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 己未，彥忠降，供奉官齊延祚殺之。

translations.literal: On jiwei Yanchong surrendered; Palace Attendant officer Qi Yanzuo killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yanchong submitted; Palace Attendant officer Qi Yanzuo then slew him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，封回鶻可汗王仁美為奉化可汗。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi, Uyghur khan Wang Renmei was enfeoffed as Khan of Offering Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the fourth month Wang Renmei, khan of the Uyghurs, received the title Offering Transformation Khan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，廢樞密使。

translations.literal: On jiashen the office of commissioner of military affairs was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the throne abolished the commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，復禁鑄錢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, coin casting was again forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the seventh month private coin was banned again.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，桑維翰罷。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renshen, Sang Weihan left office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the intercalary month Sang Weihan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，河決博平。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, jihai, the Yellow River burst its banks at Boping.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the eighth month the Yellow River broke through at Boping.

sentences.zh: 西戎寇涇州，彰義軍節度使張彥澤敗之，執其首領野離羅蝦獨。

translations.literal: Western barbarians raided Jing; Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Zhangyi, defeated them and captured their leader Yeliluoxiadú.
translations.idiomatic: Western tribes struck Jing; Zhang Yanzhe of Zhangyi drove them off and took their chief Yeliluoxiadú prisoner.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，契丹使粘木孤來。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingchou, Khitan envoy Zhanmugu came.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the ninth month the Khitan envoy Zhanmugu arrived.

sentences.zh: 癸未，封李從益為郇國公以奉唐後。

translations.literal: On guiwei Li Congyi was enfeoffed as Duke of Xun to sustain the Tang line.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Congyi was made Duke of Xun to keep the Tang succession alive.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，高麗王建使其廣評侍郎邢順來。

translations.literal: On bingxu Wang Jian of Goryeo sent his vice minister of broad deliberation Xing Shun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Wang Jian of Goryeo sent Vice Minister Xing Shun of Broad Deliberation.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙亥，立唐高祖、太宗、莊宗、明宗、湣帝廟於西京。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on yihai, temples to Tang Gaozu, Taizong, Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and the Deposed Emperor were established in the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the eleventh month shrines to Tang Gaozu, Taizong, Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and the Deposed Emperor were raised in the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，契丹使遙折來，吐蕃罷延族來附。

translations.literal: On wuzi Khitan envoy Yao Zhe came; the Tibetan Bayan clan came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Khitan envoy Yao Zhe arrived; the Tibetan Bayan clan submitted.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁卯朔，德音除民公私債。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifth year, on the first day dingmao, an edict of grace cancelled public and private debts of the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the fifth year a grace edict wiped out public and private debts owed by the people.

sentences.zh: 己丑，回鶻使石海金來。

translations.literal: On jichou the Uyghur envoy Shi Haijin came.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Uyghur envoy Shi Haijin arrived.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，契丹興化王來。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi, the Khitan Prince of Xinghua came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the fourth month the Khitan Prince of Xinghua came to court.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，安遠軍節度使李金全叛附於唐。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Li Jinquan, military governor of Anyuan, rebelled and went over to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the fifth month Li Jinquan of Anyuan defected to Tang.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，李遣其將李承裕入於安州，金全奔於唐，安遠軍節度使馬全節及承裕戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On guimao Li sent his general Li Chengyu into An prefecture; Jinquan fled to Tang; Ma Quanjie of Anyuan fought Chengyu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li sent Li Chengyu into An; Jinquan fled to Tang; Ma Quanjie of Anyuan met Chengyu in battle and broke him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，克安州，承裕奔於雲夢，全節執而殺之。

translations.literal: On dingsi An was taken; Chengyu fled to Yunmeng; Quanjie captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi An fell; Chengyu fled to Yunmeng; Quanjie seized him and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁酉，閱稼於西郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingyou, the emperor inspected the crops in the western suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the eighth month the emperor reviewed the harvest in the western suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己未，西京留守楊光遠殺太子太師範延光。

translations.literal: On jiwei Yang Guangyuan, western capital regent, killed Grand Preceptor Fan Yanguang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yang Guangyuan, regent of the Western Capital, murdered Grand Preceptor Fan Yanguang.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎和凝為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingmao, He Ning, Hanlin academician in charge and vice minister of revenue, became vice director of the Chancellery and co-grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the ninth month He Ning, Hanlin director and vice minister of revenue, entered the Chancellery as co-grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，閱稼於沙臺。

translations.literal: On xinsi crop inspection at Shatai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he reviewed the harvest at Shatai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，契丹使舍利來。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei, Khitan envoy Sheli came.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the tenth month the Khitan envoy Sheli arrived.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，冬至，始用二舞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, at the winter solstice, the two dances were first used.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the eleventh month, at the winter solstice, the court first performed the two ritual dances.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊寅，封唐叔虞為興安王，臺駘為昌寧公。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixth year, on wuyin of the first month, Tang Shuyu was enfeoffed as Prince of Xing’an and Tailu as Duke of Changning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the first month in the sixth year Tang Shuyu was made Prince of Xing’an and Tailu Duke of Changning.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，停買宴錢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wushen, the banquet-purchase levy was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the second month the throne stopped collecting banquet-purchase money.

sentences.zh: 三月，除民二年至四年以前稅。

translations.literal: In the third month, taxes owed from years two through four prior were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month arrears on taxes from the second through fourth years were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，契丹使述括來。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiwei, Khitan envoy Shukuo came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the fourth month the Khitan envoy Shukuo arrived.

sentences.zh: 五月，吐渾首領白承福來。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Tuyuhun chief Bai Chengfu came.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Tuyuhun chief Bai Chengfu came to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，突厥使薛同海來。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, Turkish envoy Xue Tonghai came.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the seventh month the Turkish envoy Xue Tonghai arrived.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，如鄴都，開封尹鄭王重貴留守東京，宣徽南院使張從恩東京內外兵馬都監。

translations.literal: On renchen he went to the capital of Ye; Prince of Zheng Chonggui, metropolitan magistrate of Kaifeng, remained to guard the Eastern Capital; Zhang Cong’en of the Southern Palace Bureau became overall supervisor of inner and outer horse and foot at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he traveled to Ye. Prince of Zheng Chonggui, Kaifeng metropolitan magistrate, stayed to guard the Eastern Capital; Zhang Cong’en of the Southern Palace Bureau took overall command of its inner and outer forces.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On renyin a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，光祿卿張澄使於契丹。

translations.literal: On jiayin Zhang Cheng, director of the Imperial Feast Office, went on embassy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhang Cheng, director of the Imperial Feast Office, went on embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，前安國軍節度使楊彥詢使於契丹。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai, Yang Yanxun, former military governor of Anguo, went on embassy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the ninth month Yang Yanxun, former governor of Anguo, went on embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，吐渾使白可久來。

translations.literal: On dingchou Tuyuhun envoy Bai Kejiu came.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Tuyuhun envoy Bai Kejiu arrived.

sentences.zh: 河決中都，入於沓河。

translations.literal: The river burst at Zhongdu and poured into the Tahe.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through at Zhongdu and ran into the Tahe.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，河決滑、濮、鄆、澶州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter the river broke through at Hua, Pu, Yan, and Chan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the river flooded Hua, Pu, Yan, and Chan.

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度使安從進反。

translations.literal: An Congjin, military governor of Shannan East Circuit, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin, governor of Shannan East Circuit, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，西京留守高行周為南面軍前都部署以討之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Gao Xingzhou, western capital regent, became overall forward deployment commander of the southern army to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the eleventh month Gao Xingzhou, regent of the Western Capital, was named overall forward commander of the southern army to crush him.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，鄭王重貴為廣晉尹，徙封齊王。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, bingxu, Prince of Zheng Chonggui became metropolitan magistrate of Guangjin and was transferred to Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the twelfth month Prince of Zheng Chonggui became Guangjin metropolitan magistrate and was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 先鋒都指揮使郭金海及安從進戰於唐州，敗之。

translations.literal: Vanguard commander Guo Jinhai fought An Congjin at Tang prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard commander Guo Jinhai met An Congjin at Tang and routed him.

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度使安重榮反。

translations.literal: An Chongrong, military governor of Chengde, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: An Chongrong, governor of Chengde, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 天平節度使杜重威為鎮州行營招討使。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, military governor of Tianping, became campaign commissioner for the Zhenzhou field army.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei of Tianping was made campaign commissioner against Zhen.

sentences.zh: 丙申，契丹遣使者來。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Khitan sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Khitan envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，杜重威及安重榮戰於宗城，敗之。

translations.literal: On wuxu Du Chongwei fought An Chongrong at Zongcheng and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Du Chongwei met An Chongrong at Zongcheng and broke his army.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丁巳，克鎮州，安重榮伏誅，赦廣晉。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventh year, on dingsi of the first month, Zhen prefecture was taken; An Chongrong was executed; Guangjin was granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the first month in the seventh year Zhen fell; An Chongrong was put to death; Guangjin received amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚午，契丹使達剌來。

translations.literal: On gengwu Khitan envoy Dala came.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Khitan envoy Dala arrived.

sentences.zh: 三月，歸德軍節度使安彥威塞決河於滑州。

translations.literal: In the third month An Yanwei, military governor of Guide, blocked the breached river at Hua.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month An Yanwei of Guide dammed the breach at Hua.

sentences.zh: 閏月，天興蝗食麥。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month locusts at Tianxing ate the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month locusts at Tianxing devoured the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙巳，尊皇太妃劉氏為太后。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yisi, Imperial Consort Liu was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the fifth month Imperial Consort Liu was raised to empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，吐渾使念醜漢來。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingchen, Tuyuhun envoy Nian Chouhan came.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the sixth month the Tuyuhun envoy Nian Chouhan arrived.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇帝崩於保昌殿。

translations.literal: On yichou the emperor died at the Hall of Preserved Glory.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor died in the Hall of Preserved Glory.
